_notes: Runtime config for the Agent Arena host page. The build copies this file (with contract addresses filled from contracts/deployments/<chain>.json when present) next to index.html; it can be edited after deployment without rebuilding Unity.
profile: the default profile. With allowProfileOverride, ?profile=<name> selects another profile defined here (only these; a link can never inject an arbitrary server or contract).
apiBase: game server origin. Empty = the page's own origin (serve the build and the API from one host, or reverse-proxy /v1). The testnet profile points at the DigitalOcean server (server/deploy).

Network values for Robinhood Chain testnet (46630) are from https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/connecting as recorded in contracts/README.md. There is deliberately no mainnet (4663) profile: mainnet needs explicit developer approval.
contracts.*: leave empty until deployed. Empty addresses disable that feature in the wallet layer with a clear error.
